rootCauseHypothesis.evidence: Attempt17's selector passed but its first release was 12.3029px from the validated pose, the pending object omitted playerX/playerY/playerAngle, and the replay never reached frame302. The current collision loop integrates the player before sweep detection and then anchors using the integrated player transform, while Attempt11 proves the desired coordinates and near-zero tap corrections.
rootCauseHypothesis.changeHypothesis: On a qualifying early separating runway top sharp contact, snapshot the integrated player transform at the pre-response/pre-anchor branch. Retain supportId, support-relative offsets, absolute playerX/playerY/playerAngle, and age together; do not substitute sweep-impact or contact-point coordinates. On tap, resolve the active support plus offsets, restore the stored angle and absolute pose, then apply unchanged standard anchored-release launch semantics. Keep the existing per-edge/lifecycle behavior narrow and do not add follow gain or TTL changes.
